claude.performance_metric: $94.0M goodwill impairment (FY2018) on Smart & Final reporting unit; taken private ~$545M June 2019
claude.rationale: The slice documents realized financial deterioration (net losses of ~$138.9M in FY2017 and ~$112.2M in FY2018, and successive goodwill impairments of $180.0M and $94.0M on the Smart & Final stores reporting unit), and format execution via 201 Extra!-format stores including 105 legacy conversions/relocations, but it does not attribute any disruption specifically to a product/process interface, so p4 is uncertain. No line documents any operations-versus-people/management/culture fracture; the record shows only financial results and a go-private merger, so p5 is coded 0 as not-documented. The slice explicitly states the acquired properties are not separately reported and that the record is truncated by the July 2019 deregistration, leaving archetype and business-model reconciliation channels undeterminable.

grok.performance_metric: ~$94M goodwill impairment FY2018; taken private ~$545M Jun 2019
grok.rationale: The slice reports successive net losses and goodwill impairments on the Smart & Final stores reporting unit plus Extra!-format store counts, but does not document any realized inability to align an acquired product with operating processes over time, so p4_pathway is 0. It likewise contains no evidence of operations-versus-organization/culture fracture after the deal, so p5_pathway is 0. Public reporting ends with the FY2018 10-K and the June 2019 Apollo take-private/Form 15 deregistration, with no pathway-level disruption described.
